records.name: Mastra
records.one_liner: A broad framework whose agent loop is a workflow; durable recovery is an explicit persistence configuration, not implied by durable:true alone.
builds_on: AI SDK provider specifications; bundled SDK v4–v7

features_notes.durable_resume: Requires durable agent, persistent store and running-snapshot recovery policy; ordinary Agent is suspend/resume only.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Core offers opt-in seatbelt/bwrap; default none, and Mastra Code does not enable isolation.
features_notes.ide: ACP and integrations, not a native IDE extension.
features_notes.plugins: Framework programmatic extensions plus Mastra Code plugin surface.

dims.loop: Own AgenticLoopBuilder composes a workflow iteration around provider doStream calls.
dims.providers: AI SDK provider specs V2/V3/V4, model router and gateway/fallback adapters.
dims.tools: Tools, processor stages, tool approval/suspension and delegated agent tools.
dims.context: Memory processors, observational memory, skills and coding-product instructions.
dims.state: Workflow snapshots; DurableAgent persists running state only with recovery/custom policy or shutdown; remote effects can repeat.
dims.safety: Approvals, guardrails and opt-in native/remote sandboxes; Mastra Code shell runs unconfined after approval.
dims.extensibility: Processors, hooks, storage/workspace adapters, MCP client/server and product plugins.
dims.multi_agent: Workflow parallel/branch/loops, agent networks, delegated tools and protocol wrappers.
dims.surfaces: In-process framework, Studio/server/deployers and separate Mastra Code SDK/TUI/ACP/Factory.
dims.observability: Tracing/OTel, scorers, datasets and eval/experiment tooling.

key_insights: A broad framework whose agent loop is a workflow; durable recovery is an explicit persistence configuration, not implied by durable:true alone.
Workflow snapshots; DurableAgent persists running state only with recovery/custom policy or shutdown; remote effects can repeat.
Approvals, guardrails and opt-in native/remote sandboxes; Mastra Code shell runs unconfined after approval.

checked_claims: Storage generation fence versus lease-only fallback
Isolated native sandbox network default false
Mastra Code constructs LocalSandbox without isolation
corrections: Corrected claim that DurableAgent always writes running snapshots
Added recovery policy and graceful-shutdown distinction
Clarified durable:true alone does not guarantee hard-crash recovery
unresolved: Fencing guarantees depend on selected storage adapter and were not tested under concurrent workers.
Enterprise license implications are reported from repository text, not legal advice.
verification.scope: Static inspection of selected high-impact claims. Not an exhaustive claim audit; no cloned code executed. Manifest/loop/recovery/safety boundaries prioritized.
